profile.summary: Bengal & Assam Company Limited operates as an investment company in India and internationally. It is also involved in the investment in securities; and trading of goods. The company was formerly known as Bengal & Assam Investors Limited and changed its name to Bengal & Assam Company Limited in June 1982. Bengal & Assam Company Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is based in New Delhi, India.
